name: Medieval House (中世纪民居)
use_for: medieval town/village houses, inns, taverns, blacksmiths, market-stall homes; timber-framed or wood-panelled 2-storey houses
palette_stats: GrabCraft medieval-houses 150 件去地形统计: oak_planks 10.8% / spruce_planks 8.8% / spruce_log 8.4% / cobblestone 8.1% / oak_log 5.8% / stone_bricks 5.8% / spruce_stairs 5.1% / oak_stairs 4.6% — 木骨石基是本风格的实测主流

proportions.typical_footprint: 7x9 ~ 13x15; town houses narrow-fronted (宽 5-7 临街), 深 9-13
proportions.jetty: upper storey overhangs ground floor by 1 on front (+sides if detached) — the medieval look; support the overhang ends with upside-down stair brackets (patterns/balcony.py support=brackets 同理)

materials.ground_floor_mix: 60% cobblestone / 25% stone_bricks / 15% mossy_cobblestone, deterministic per-position (patterns/wall_weathering.py preset=cobble_rustic); 石基上浅下深铁律:最底 1-2 层 mossy 占比加倍
materials.upper_walls_mix: two systems, pick per building: (a) wood-panelled: 70% oak_planks / 30% spruce_planks; (b) timber-framed: white_terracotta infill + spruce_log frame (patterns/wall_weathering.py preset=plaster_timber)
materials.frame_use: corner posts + storey band beams + jetty beam; log axis derived by script, never hand-set
materials.roof_use: spruce_stairs main slope (stats: stairs ≈10% of all blocks — roof is a huge visible area, never skimp); dark_oak for richer houses
materials.accent_use: trapdoor shutters + wall-mounted detail panels, fence balcony rail (patterns/railing.py), lantern by door

roof.type: gable (人字顶) steep; hip for corner plots (patterns/hip_roof.py)
roof.slope: 45~60 degrees; medieval roofs are TALL — ridge height ≈ 0.6~1.0x wall height
roof.ridge_support: solid beam via patterns/gable_roof.py ridge_support (已实机验证, 禁止悬空半砖脊)
roof.dormers: 1-2 gabled dormers on long slopes (patterns/dormer.py), 屋顶开窗的正规做法
roof.chimney: patterns/chimney.py 1x1 or 1x2 stone_bricks shaft on gable end or rear slope, campfire smoke

windows.pattern: irregular but balanced: 1-2 per storey per face, aligned vertically when stacked; ground floor windows smaller/higher (defense look)
windows.frame: patterns/window_trim.py projection=1 spruce_stairs; spruce_trapdoor shutters both sides; arch_window for inn/chapel-grade buildings

details.base: 1-2 block cobblestone footing flare at ground contact, mossy at bottom — never floating walls
details.balcony: optional front balcony on upper storey: patterns/balcony.py cantilever + railing=fence + support=brackets
details.signage: inn/shop: hanging sign on spruce_fence bracket arm over the door, barrel/cauldron street clutter
details.lighting: lantern on fence post or wall torch at door; interior lantern per room (patterns/interior_rooms.py)
details.weathering: patterns/wall_weathering.py: gradient=true (mossy toward base), vine_pct 5-10 on shaded faces
details.interior: ground floor = shop/tavern/storeroom, upper = bedroom(s); use patterns/interior_rooms.py + interior_layout.md 分房五步法; 内部绝不能留空壳

pilaster.note: timber-frame verticals double as pilasters on plaster system

string_course.note: jetty beam line IS the string course between storeys

pitfalls: 外立面全平无框架 — 必须有 corner posts + band beams + window_trim, 光秃秃是上一版实测翻车点
屋顶只用半砖平顶 — 中世纪屋顶必须陡坡+实芯脊, 参考 roof_types.md
上层不挑出 — jetty 悬挑 1 格是风格灵魂, 但挑出端必须带支撑托
内部空壳 — 壳→分房→门窗→陈设顺序不可颠倒(interior_layout.md)
石基和木墙之间无过渡 — 用 string_course 梁线收边
